sources.snippet: This document provides detailed technical documentation for the WanTransformer3DModel class, the core transformer architecture in LingBot-VA. This model implements a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) design that simultaneously processes video latents and action sequences for autoregressive robot control.
